summary: Develop the confidence to tackle tough talks head-on with our Leading and Managing Difficult Conversations Course. Take your communication skills to the next le
lede: Managing difficult conversations involves using structured communication to address workplace friction and keep discussions productive. For team leads, HR professionals and managers, the course develops skills in assessing conflict styles, delivering objective feedback with the SBI model, coaching performance with GROW, and using active listening and mediation approaches.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who are responsible for team output, organizational culture, and the resolution of complex interpersonal or operational disputes.
modules: Conflict Assessment and the TKI® Model
The Anatomy of a Difficult Conversation
Evidence-Based Feedback with the SBI Model
Performance Coaching and the GROW Model
Managing Up and Lateral Stakeholder Alignment
Communication in Hybrid and Digital Workflows
Integration and Sustaining a Feedback Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in a supervisory or project management role. Familiarity with basic performance management processes is recommended. No prior knowledge of specific psychological frameworks is required.
